label: <DEL> delimiter step in short sequences (L<=6)
explanation: Fires mainly on the <DEL> delimiter step, which holds 84% of the activation mass. Firing depends strongly on sequence length: at the delimiter it fires on nearly all L<=5 sequences (precision 0.96 for L<=5) and on part of L=6, and rarely for L>=7. The largest activations (top quartile, ~99% covered) are delimiters in L=3-4 sequences, so magnitude falls as L grows. It never fires during the original-input phase. The remaining ~16% of mass is weak, scattered copy-phase activations at various recall positions (somewhat more at recall_idx 2 for short sequences, and at t=11 and t=17) that do not follow one clean rule, so recall is incomplete (0.60).
